threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in an internet edge router or the unsupported CO-1 session border controller to gain a foothold
threat_source: Nation-state or cybercriminal group targeting carriers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Critical vendor advisories open on both edge routers; CO-1 SBC past vendor support; SBC management interface reachable from the internet edge VLAN
treatment_plan: Emergency patch of edge routers; restrict SBC management to jump hosts now; replace the SBC; monthly authenticated scans

threat_event: Intruder moves through the management plane and steals call detail records from the mediation archive (P08 scenario)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Management network reachable from corporate network; mediation service account with broad rights; no security monitoring; 36-month CDR archive
existing_controls: EDR on corporate endpoints; VPN between COs and cloud
treatment_plan: Segment the management plane; scope the mediation service account to read-only pulls; managed detection; shorten CDR retention

threat_event: Fraudster takes over a customer's online account through the password reset (date of birth and SSN4) and views call detail or ports the number
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup authentication uses readily available biographical information
treatment_plan: One-time-code reset to the telephone number or email of record; alert on reset bursts

threat_event: Pretexter obtains call detail by phone from an overflow call center agent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Overflow vendor agents untrained on CPNI; call detail visible after SSN4 check
existing_controls: In-house agents require the account password
treatment_plan: Remove call detail screens from the vendor role; CPNI training; monthly call sampling

threat_event: Chatbot discloses account details to an unauthenticated user or through prompt manipulation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quick help mode verified users with account number and ZIP code; free-text input reaches an account API
existing_controls: Quick help disabled 2026-07-31; portal-authenticated sessions only
treatment_plan: Keep quick help off; API scoped to the logged-in account; red-team test before general launch (P10)

threat_event: Chatbot suggests broadband plans using voice CPNI without the customer's approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Chatbot API does not carry the CPNI approval flag
treatment_plan: Upsell disabled until the approval flag is checked in the API

threat_event: Attacker with network element access reconfigures or wipes OLTs and aggregation switches, causing a service-area-wide outage including 911 calling
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared local admin accounts on OLTs, DSLAMs, cabinet switches; no MFA except core routers
existing_controls: TACACS+ with MFA on core routers; nightly config backups
treatment_plan: Named TACACS+ accounts with MFA on every element type; remove shared accounts; jump hosts

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the cloud tenant (OSS, mediation, portal) and deletes backups in the same account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Snapshots in the same account and region; admin roles can delete backups; no restore test
existing_controls: Daily snapshots; MFA on cloud console
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Ransomware on corporate endpoints spreads to NOC tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: NOC workstations on the corporate network; EDR alerts not watched after hours
existing_controls: EDR on all laptops and desktops
treatment_plan: 24x7 managed detection; move NOC workstations to the management segment

threat_event: Attacker activity goes undetected for months because no one reviews security logs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SIEM; 30-day syslog retention; NOC watches availability only
treatment_plan: Managed detection service with 1-year log retention and management-plane login alerts

threat_event: A CPNI breach is not reported to the USSS and FBI within 7 business days, leading to FCC enforcement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CPNI breach procedure; staff unaware of the reporting facility
treatment_plan: P08 runbook and matrix; reporting facility access; leadership briefing

threat_event: FCC enforcement action because the annual CPNI certification statement is inaccurate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Boilerplate statement; no complaint log
treatment_plan: Counsel review; evidence file for the CY2026 statement

threat_event: Compromise of the lawful-intercept system exposes surveillance targets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-10 shares the management network path; no compromise reporting procedure
existing_controls: Restricted room; 3 named users; TTP handles delivery
treatment_plan: Dedicated isolated management path for SYS-10; compromise reporting in P08; quarterly access review

threat_event: Law enforcement cannot reach the CALEA senior officer and the FCC finds the SSI plan stale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan filed 2014; outdated appendix and designee
treatment_plan: Rewrite and refile through CEFS

threat_event: Hurricane damages outside plant and CO power, causing a multi-day outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Aerial fiber in rural areas; generator fuel for 72 hours
treatment_plan: Fuel contracts for 7 days; pre-staged restoration crews; storm tabletop each May

threat_event: Fiber cut on the single route between CO-1 and CO-2 isolates the CO-2 serving area
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only one fiber route between central offices
treatment_plan: Build a diverse route (capital plan)

threat_event: PSAP is not notified within 30 minutes of an outage affecting 911
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PSAP contact list last confirmed 2024
treatment_plan: Confirm contacts now and every January

threat_event: An interconnected VoIP outage is not reported to NORS on time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: NOC worksheet has wireline criteria only
treatment_plan: Add VoIP criteria to the worksheet

threat_event: Former employee or contractor uses a shared network device password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared local admin passwords not rotated at departures
existing_controls: Accounts in the identity provider disabled at termination
treatment_plan: Rotate shared passwords now; named accounts (R-007 plan)

threat_event: Phished workforce account is used to export customer records from the BSS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push-based MFA; bulk export allowed for 14 roles
treatment_plan: Number-matching MFA; limit bulk export to 3 roles; export alerts

threat_event: Care agent looks up and sells call detail or customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of BSS access logs; broad agent access
treatment_plan: Monthly access report review; CPNI sanctions; VIP and employee account alerts

threat_event: A vendor handling CPNI (chatbot, contact center, overflow call center) suffers a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security reviews or breach notice terms for these vendors
treatment_plan: Security reviews; contract addenda with 24-hour incident notice and CPNI terms

threat_event: BSS vendor outage longer than the customer care RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS billing and care platform
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: vendor RTO 4 h meets the BIA; care uses the offline account lookup report

threat_event: SS7 signaling abuse through the SS7 hub provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Signaling filtering is the hub provider's responsibility; not reviewed
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: residual risk Low for a wireline carrier without mobile subscribers; review hub provider controls in 2027

threat_event: Configuration backup server fails and devices cannot be restored quickly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Config backups on a single CO-1 server
treatment_plan: Copy configs to the cloud backup account and an offline store

threat_event: Intruder at a remote cabinet connects to a switch console port
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keyed cabinets; console ports enabled
treatment_plan: Console authentication through TACACS+; alarm response procedure

threat_event: DDoS attack overwhelms DNS and broadband service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Limited on-net mitigation
existing_controls: Upstream transit provider scrubbing on request
treatment_plan: Contract always-on scrubbing with the upstream transit provider

threat_event: Unneeded SSN4 and date of birth in the BSS enlarge breach impact
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Credit-check data kept for the life of the account
treatment_plan: Stop using SSN4 for authentication; purge after credit decision

threat_event: Stolen CDR archive exposes 36 months of calling history
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Archive retention longer than billing dispute needs
treatment_plan: Reduce online archive to 18 months; move older records to encrypted cold storage with separate keys

threat_event: Lost or stolen field technician tablet exposes cached work orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tablets hold 7 days of work orders
existing_controls: MDM with remote wipe and device encryption
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three administrators with standing access
existing_controls: Hardware security keys for cloud admins
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Attacker uses default SNMP community strings on cabinet switches to map or change the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-default SNMP strings on 11 cabinet switches (found in P07 testing)
treatment_plan: Replace strings; SNMPv3 with authentication; add to configuration baseline

threat_event: Marketing uses stale opt-out approvals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Biennial notice overdue
treatment_plan: Mail notice; pause opt-out campaigns for 30 days

threat_event: Chatbot gives wrong billing or payment arrangement answers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generative answers on billing policy; limited testing
treatment_plan: Answer from approved knowledge base only; weekly transcript sampling (P10)
